default.description: Pre-filled widget value; must match the field type.

description.description: Widget tooltip explaining the field to the designer.

label.description: Widget label shown in the form.

maximum.description: Upper bound for integer/number fields; required for them (ED-30 spinbox range).

minimum.description: Lower bound for integer/number fields; required for them (ED-30 spinbox range).

options.description: Choices for an enum field; required for type 'enum'.

required.description: When true the field gates the dialog's Dispatch button. Default false.

type.description: Widget kind: string (line edit), text (multi-line), boolean (checkbox), integer/number (spinbox), enum (combo box).

description: data/agent_forms/<id>.json (THIRD schema-pairing exception in tools/smoke.py, same pattern as map_file/balancing_history): one agent-dispatch form spec per game thing-type. The editor renders the dialog from this spec; submitting writes a dispatch_handoff.schema.json payload. The free-text description box is built into the dialog, NOT a spec field - every form gets it for free.

context.description: Repo-relative docs the spawned agent reads first; copied verbatim into the handoff.

description.description: One paragraph shown under the dialog title.

fields.description: Structured fields rendered above the git group, in order.

git_default.description: Pre-selected git mode in the dialog: 'branch' (worktree off Development, ends with a PR) or 'current' (in place, stop-and-confirm).

id.description: Must equal the filename stem (loader-enforced); also the branch-name prefix (agent/<id>-<slug>).

schema_version.description: Spec format version. The renderer rejects unknown versions loudly.

selector_context.description: Optional data/slots.json category key whose selector-tree node offers this form via right-click (AD-6).

skill.description: Target slash command; .claude/commands/<skill>.md must exist (AD-4 sweep enforces).

slug_field.description: Field key whose value names the auto branch (default 'name'; falls back to the free-text box).

title.description: Dialog window title, e.g. 'Add New Enemy'.

title: agent_form
